newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Seven accepts Optus Vision offers.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Seven accepts Optus Vision offers.

text.p: Seven Network Ltd said on Friday that it accepted offers to buy the remaining 98 percent of pay television operator Optus Vision it does not already own.

The two offers made to Seven's subsidiary Tallglen arise from a legal dispute between the television network and the other Optus Vision shareholders. Seven initiated the legal action, alleging the shareholders had breached the Optus Vision shareholders agreement and claiming that this meant Seven had the right to buyout the majority holdings.

As a result of the claims, Seven received two offers to buy the pay tv group on February 10 but most analysts said the sale would never eventuate and that shareholders would fight Seven in the courts, with the case to be heard again on February 24.
